title: Core: AS2 Math object built-in methods
description: Test compilation of Math object: Math.abs(x), Math.ceil(x), Math.floor(x), Math.round(x), Math.sqrt(x), Math.pow(x,y), Math.min(a,b), Math.max(a,b), Math.random(), Math.PI, Math.E, Math.log(x), Math.sin(x), Math.cos(x), Math.tan(x), Math.atan2(y,x). Each should compile without error. Verify Math.PI emits ActionGetMember (0x4f) on the Math global object.
